checks.name: original templates are separate valid editable artwork with actual union geometry
overdraw changes colour without multiplying mass, inertia, reach or swing
equal ink farther from the fixed grip increases inertia and slows handling
actual contact distinguishes a hole from ink with the same bounding box
disconnected drawings remain separate occupied regions, never a filled envelope
mirror and angle transform preserve the visible grip-to-ink vectors
a swept thin tip cannot tunnel between two visible attack poses
malformed, nonfinite, out of canvas and oversized gesture inputs are rejected
empty and overbudget art retain safe drawing feedback and cannot start a round
phase-gated actions use explicit success replies and exact visible artwork
each attack can damage an opponent at most once and has visible recovery
dodge consumes stamina and has independent cooldown, avoiding invulnerability spam
pause freezes all combat, phase clocks, stamina, effects and event emission
fixed simulation is identical at 30 and 120 fps for the same timed input
manual movement is bounded, reversing sides keeps collision/pose facing coherent
a full ordinary public-input tournament visits all 3 opponents and earns only at finish
no input still completes all rounds; losses do not trap the workshop or award fabricated wins
new rounds restore health and stamina and allow an actual geometry refit
unfinished reload and cancel preserve earned progress/art but never unfinished score
local save validation recovers from corrupt records and separately rescues malformed art
snapshot mutation cannot alter active contacts, saved art or future defaults
ordinary input exposes shape tradeoffs: a wide close clump is not a universal winner
all phase deadlines total 186 active seconds with 3 natural timeout judgements
